_meta.note: pumps.doseLines: Zone A's calibrated pump rate, 15 mL/min = 0.25 mL/s for N, P and K (farm details form, R-1, section 5: average of three 60 s runs). This file has one rate per dose line, and Zone B's pumps run 1 L/min, 67 times faster, so only Zone A (ZC1) runs on the rig until per-zone pump rates come in T1-31's pump-rate PR.
